goal: Open Google Chrome, navigate to https://sheets.new, enter headers 'Item' in A1 and 'Revenue' in B1, then create a new sheet tab named 'Summary' and enter 'Total' in A1.

input_purposes: URL to open a new Google Sheet
Header for Column A in Sheet1 cell A1
Header for Column B in Sheet1 cell B1
Name for the new second sheet tab
Label for summary metric in Summary sheet cell A1
required_sequence: Navigate to https://sheets.new in Google Chrome
Enter headers 'Item' in A1 and 'Revenue' in B1 in Sheet1
Add a new sheet tab and rename it to 'Summary'
Select cell A1 in the Summary tab and enter 'Total'
Verify both tabs exist with correct data and select done
success: A new Google Sheet is open in Google Chrome
Sheet1 contains 'Item' in A1 and 'Revenue' in B1
A second sheet tab named 'Summary' exists with 'Total' in A1
